import base64, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path('products/sites/sqlite-join-exercise')
files = sorted(path for path in root.rglob('*') if path.is_file())
archives = []
for path in files:
    if path.name.endswith('.zip.b64'):
        payload = base64.b64decode(b''.join(path.read_bytes().split()), validate=True)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload)) as archive:
            members = [{'path': member.filename, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(archive.read(member)).hexdigest()} for member in archive.infolist() if not member.is_dir()]
        archives.append({'path': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'decoded_sha256': hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), 'members': members})
index_hash = hashlib.sha256((root / 'index.html').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
expected_archive = '8325a93711826740de4fffb9d43a312b048b26a43212280fd53df55fb5c11eb2'
result = {'dry_run_reference': 'TASK-179583123200', 'index_sha256': index_hash, 'index_matches_receipt': index_hash == 'db488f1c222947df9bdc014ff4a0cd1e83fd408547da7602b98774ef1654eb50', 'files': [str(path.relative_to(root)) for path in files], 'archives': archives, 'archive_matches_verified_preview': len(archives) == 1 and archives[0]['decoded_sha256'] == expected_archive, 'scope': 'Payload identity only. Redistribution and independent approval require separate evidence.'}
out = pathlib.Path('products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot/standalone-payload-binding.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
